title: clone-any-site repurpose manifest
description: Single source of truth for the Repurpose Layer. One numbered manifest drives two targets: an internal loopback mirror-preview (max fidelity) and a publishable build. Edit once, both stay in sync. Tracked in git; preview/build payloads are not.

target.description: Original URL studied (provenance only; never the deploy target).

generatedAtRef.description: Caller-stamped timestamp (scripts never call Date.now themselves for determinism).

mirrorRoot.description: Relative path to the served loopback mirror root.

buildFingerprint.description: <build-id>+<crawl-log-hash>. A stale manifest applied to a fresh mirror is refused.

structureAuthorization.description: Set per public deploy by the publish-gate attestation. authorized => DOM-derivative target allowed; unauthorized => clean-room rebuild forced.

seo.description: Head SEO. `original` = captured from the source (do not ship as-is); `replacement` = the user's overrides; the build emits replacement-over-original so the shipped page carries YOUR title/description/OG, not the cloned site's.

grouped.description: Slots that belong to a same-content group (groupId set).

blocking.description: Content originals not yet kept/replaced (advanced slots excluded) — the 'N slots block publish' counter.

number.description: Stable, section-scoped + content-anchored. The user swaps by this number ('replace #N').

stableId.description: sha-derived id of the content anchor, e.g. img-hero-3f9a. Stable across runs of a frozen mirror.

clId.description: v1.1 document-wide stable anchor (12 hex). Primary locator: stamped as data-cl-id; survives DOM-order churn / React re-render. Unique per manifest.

groupId.description: v1.1 same-content group key — slots sharing normalized text or a media basename. Editing the group changes all members ('change all N').

groupRole.description: First-in-document member of a group is 'primary'.

directOnly.description: Text element that also has element children — edit its DIRECT text nodes only, never textContent (which would delete nested slots).

alt.description: Editable alt text for an image slot (accessibility + SEO). Build writes it onto the swapped/kept .

altReplacement.description: User override for alt text; build prefers this over the original alt.

section.description: Section-slot layout overrides (manifest-only, reversible). { hidden: bool } drops the whole section; { order: int } reorders it among its sibling sections. Never touches the section's internals/CSS.

order.description: Sibling reorder index — sections in a shared parent are sorted by this. null/absent = keep natural order.

srcsetSpec.description: v1.1 responsive shape of an image (picture/img-srcset/plain) so a swap REBUILDS srcset instead of stripping it.

sourcesSpec.description: v1.1 video <source> list to rebuild on swap.

advanced.description: v1.1 flagged advanced content (e.g. css gradient cssValue) — not a first-class drop target, excluded from blocking.

role.description: chrome (nav/footer/legal/copyright/address/phone) is hidden from the edit-map VIEW but NEVER from the scan; chrome originals count toward 'blocking'.

clId.description: v1.1 primary anchor (== slot.clId), resolved as [data-cl-id] before cssPath/nth/bbox fallback.

bbox.description: Per-viewport bounding box [x,y,w,h]; absent key => not present at that viewport (e.g. hidden on mobile).

sourceAnchor.description: Clean-room marker the publishable scaffold reads, e.g. data-slot="s003" / SLOT('s003') / PILLARS[2].d. Lets the SAME manifest feed both DOM-derivative and clean-room targets.

authorization.description: Per retained original. Set by the publish-gate attestation; null until then.

currentValue.description: For text: the actual text content. For media: human-readable label.

currentValueRef.description: mirror://… path to the current asset (media) or inline ref (text).

srcset.description: v1.1 rebuilt srcset string applied to the swapped (so responsiveness is preserved, not stripped).

poster.description: v1.1 video poster ref for the swapped <video>.

keep.description: Explicit keep — the user reviewed #N and chose to retain the original content. Required to clear a content slot from 'blocking' without a swap.

repeat.description: Folded repeats: a grid of 6 cards collapses to one head slot (count 6) + childSchema, not 6×N atoms.

childSchema.description: On a folded group head: the per-item child slot shape.

breakpointScope.description: Per-viewport variant key; merges per-breakpoint variants under the same number (different hero on mobile etc).

slotSpec.description: Per-viewport target asset spec used by fit-slot to turn a dropped file into the exact responsive set.
